title: Microsoft Dataverse: richer record labels for Copilot /mention in Microsoft 365 apps
summary: Hold: the briefing describes licensing as unpublished even though Microsoft documents the licensing of the Copilot product in which these labels appear. Distinguish that existing entitlement from the absence of a separate licence or meter for the label enhancement. The documented environment setting, its path and the roadmap facts check out.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated what the label enhancement does on arrival without administrator action, so its defaultState is unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: Dataverse Copilot /mention enhanced labels default enabled; Dataverse /mention default labels. Read the roadmap, /power-platform/admin/link-records-outlook-web and /power-platform/admin/settings-features on Learn; only the general setting has a default.

claims.claim: The path is Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features > Search > Search for records in Microsoft 365 apps.
claims.quote: select **Manage**. ... select **Environments**. ... select an environment. ... select **Settings**. ... Expand **Product**, and then select **Features**. ... Under the **Search** section, turn on **Search for records in Microsoft 365 apps**.
